name: Paint Bucket
description: A box full of marbles marked with a paint bucket. Tap it and its marbles pour out — the moment they splash down onto the belt, a burst of paint randomly recolors a few other boxes AND their matching customers, so the level stays balanced.
howToPlay: Tap the paint bucket (bottom center) to pour its marbles. Watch the splash when they land: three other boxes flip to new random colors, and their matching order slots at the bottom flip with them. Then keep sorting as usual to clear every order.
author: Claude
